note: THE PIN. test/integration/json-schema-suite.test.ts asserts every number below. Moving the submodule changes contentDigest and therefore fails the build until this file is re-measured, which is what makes a suite bump a reviewed commit. validCases / invalidCases / passingValidCases / passingInvalidCases are the source for the table comparing against a validator that only ever returns true; both the docs and the site read them from here, so neither can go stale on its own. skippedCases and passingCases come from test/json-schema/suite-skip-list.ts, so a bump cannot be recorded without re-reading the skip list. contentDigest is taken after normalising line endings to LF: the submodule sits outside this repository's .gitattributes, so what gets checked out is platform-dependent. Recorded without normalising, a digest measured on Windows fails on a Linux runner.
